name: What types of locks are available for sliding glass doors?

mainEntity.name: What types of locks are available for sliding glass doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several types of locks are available for sliding glass doors to enhance security. These include basic mortise locks, which are built into the door frame; surface-mounted locks, which attach to the door's surface; and patio door locks with key access from both sides. For increased security, you can also opt for double-bolt locks, security bars, or smart locks that integrate with home automation systems. The best choice depends on your security needs and door type.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sliding glass door locks include mortise, surface-mounted, double-bolt, and smart locks. The best type depends on your security needs.
